paragraphs.text: On 23 September 2026, the UNESCO Institute for Statistics opened a global consultation on a draft framework for measuring culture and creativity. Feedback can be submitted until 16 October 2026. The initiative asks how statistics can describe an ecosystem that includes creators, organisations, audiences and communities. The proposals remain open to revision; the full methodological manual is expected in 2027, rather than being an already completed rulebook.
paragraphs.translationJa: UNESCO統計研究所は2026年9月23日、文化と創造活動を測定する枠組みの草案について世界的な意見募集を始めた。提出期限は2026年10月16日だ。創作者、組織、観客、地域の人々を含む全体を統計でどう表すかを問う。提案は修正の余地を残しており、詳細な方法論の手引きは2027年の公表予定で、すでに完成した規則集ではない。

paragraphs.text: UIS invites national statistical offices, culture ministries, researchers, practitioners and associations to comment. This range of participants reflects the varied information needed to understand cultural activity. A ministry may focus on policy, while a practitioner can identify what a measure misses in everyday work. The announcement describes consultation as a way to refine the framework, not as proof that all participants already agree on its indicators.
paragraphs.translationJa: UISは国の統計機関、文化を担当する省、研究者、実務家、団体などに意見を求めている。参加者の幅広さは、文化活動の理解に必要な情報の多様さを表す。省は政策に注目し、実務家は日々の仕事で指標が見落とす点を指摘できる。発表は協議を枠組み改善の手段として述べており、全員がすでに指標に合意したことを示すものではない。

paragraphs.text: The draft looks beyond the money generated by cultural industries. It includes informal and community activities, as well as professional work and digital production. Its approach uses several dimensions, including economic value, cultural engagement, social conditions and governance. An employment figure can tell us something useful, but it cannot answer every question about access, participation or the conditions supporting creative work.
paragraphs.translationJa: 草案は文化産業が生む金銭だけを見ているわけではない。専門的な仕事やデジタル制作に加え、非公式な活動や地域の活動も含める。経済的価値、文化への参加、社会的な条件、統治の仕組みなど、複数の側面を使う。雇用の数字は有用だが、利用しやすさ、参加、創造活動を支える条件について、すべての問いに答えることはできない。

paragraphs.text: For this reason, the draft proposes a profile across dimensions rather than a single overall score. A high income figure cannot compensate for poor access to cultural activities. Combining everything into one ranking could conceal such differences. The aim is to examine connected measures together while preserving what each one means. The framework treats economic and social information as related but not interchangeable.
paragraphs.translationJa: このため草案は、一つの総合点ではなく複数の側面を示す一覧を提案している。収入が高くても、文化活動への参加が難しい問題を埋め合わせるわけではない。すべてを一つの順位にまとめると、違いが隠れる可能性がある。指標同士を合わせて読みながら、各指標が何を意味するかは保つことが目的だ。経済と社会の情報は関係しているが、互いに置き換えられるものではない。

paragraphs.text: Interpretation also depends on definitions and coverage. A statistic needs to identify the people or activities it counts and the period it describes. Breaking a result down by relevant characteristics can reveal differences hidden in an average. However, the draft recognises that countries have different statistical resources. It proposes progressive implementation, allowing measurement to expand as data and capacity improve without abandoning a shared framework.
paragraphs.translationJa: 解釈には定義と対象範囲も重要だ。統計は、数える人や活動、対象の期間を明らかにする必要がある。関連する属性で結果を分けると、平均に隠れた違いが見えることがある。ただし国によって統計に使える資源は異なると草案は認めている。共通の枠組みを維持しながら、データや能力の向上に合わせて測定を広げる段階的な実施を提案している。

paragraphs.text: Participants can review the executive summary and respond through a questionnaire. Their feedback will inform further development of the proposed indicators. The process makes the distinction between a draft and an adopted standard important: publishing a proposal invites examination, rather than ending debate. Readers should therefore treat the consultation as an opportunity to improve how cultural activity is understood, not as a final verdict on which culture has the greatest value. It is an invitation to examine assumptions and improve the evidence used in public discussion.
paragraphs.translationJa: 参加者は概要を読み、質問票を通じて回答できる。意見は提案された指標の今後の開発に生かされる。そのため草案と採用済みの基準を区別することが重要だ。提案の公表は検討を促す行為であり、議論の終わりではない。どの文化の価値が最も高いかを最終決定したものではなく、文化活動を捉える方法を改善する機会として読む必要がある。 公の議論に使う証拠と、その前提を見直すための呼びかけでもある。

comprehension.question: What is the consultation deadline?
choices: 16 October 2026, before the planned 2027 manual.
23 September 2026, before the consultation begins.
16 October 2027, after all indicators become final.
23 September 2027, after the manual is published.

evidence.text: Feedback can be submitted until 16 October 2026.

comprehension.explanationJa: 本文中の根拠に基づいて判断します。

comprehension.question: How does the draft propose presenting results?
choices: As a profile across several distinct dimensions.
As a single income ranking replacing all other data.
As one score measuring the quality of every artwork.
As a list limited to the biggest commercial firms.

evidence.text: For this reason, the draft proposes a profile across dimensions rather than a single overall score.

comprehension.explanationJa: 本文中の根拠に基づいて判断します。

comprehension.question: Why could one combined ranking be misleading?
choices: It could hide weak access behind strong income results.
It would include only activities that lack any value.
It would prove that consultation has already succeeded.
It could show that all dimensions measure the same thing.

evidence.text: A high income figure cannot compensate for poor access to cultural activities.

comprehension.explanationJa: 経済面が良好でも参加しやすさが低い場合がある。一つの点にすると異なる側面の問題が見えなくなるため。

opinion.prompt: What important aspect of cultural life might an income figure miss? Explain how you would examine it.

review.notes: 公開日と本文の数値・予定を一次資料で確認。日本語訳を段落IDで対応。使い方はすべて未確認。
review.translationReview: 段落IDごとに人数・割合・年月を照合し、予定は未来表現、推定や可能性は断定しない日本語に確認。

vocabularyReview.reason: framework・governance・interchangeableは重要語彙で扱う。statistical・indicatorは統計の分野語。draftと採用済み基準を区別し、総合点にしない理由をP3〜P5で説明。
